items.exampleEn: My brother came down with a cold on the first day of his trip.
items.exampleZh: 我的兄弟在旅行的第一天就染上了感冒。

items.exampleEn: The question of price came up again and again.
items.exampleZh: 價格的問題一再被提出來。

items.exampleEn: Many small shops count on tourists in the summer.
items.exampleZh: 許多小店夏天都依賴觀光客。

items.exampleEn: Sales were poor, so the company had to cut back.
items.exampleZh: 銷售不佳，公司只好縮減開支。

items.exampleEn: Our internet was cut off because we forgot to pay the bill.
items.exampleZh: 因為我們忘了繳費，網路被切斷了。

items.exampleEn: Many people now do without a TV at home.
items.exampleZh: 現在很多人家裡沒有電視也過得很好。

items.exampleEn: We need a guest list for the party. Can you draw one up?
items.exampleZh: 我們需要一份派對的客人名單，你可以草擬一份嗎？

items.sentenceEn: Please don't cut me off when I'm speaking.
items.sentenceZh: 我說話時請不要打斷我。

items.audioEn: My exam is coming up next week, so I can't go to the concert with you on Saturday.
items.audioZh: 我的考試下週就到了，所以星期六不能跟你去聽音樂會。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼不能去聽音樂會？
options: The speaker has a test soon
The concert tickets are too expensive
The speaker needs to work all weekend

items.sentenceEn: You can count on me to finish the report by Friday.
items.sentenceZh: 你可以放心，我星期五前會把報告寫完。

items.sentenceEn: Our team can't do without her careful planning.
items.sentenceZh: 我們團隊少不了她細心的規劃。

items.stemEn: The two companies' lawyers spent a week ____ the new contract.
items.stemZh: 兩家公司的律師花了一週草擬新合約。

items.stemEn: Half of my class ____ the flu last month.
items.stemZh: 上個月我們班有一半的人染上了流感。

items.passageEn: Every year, our club holds a small music festival in the park. This year, however, the city reduced its support, so we had to cut back on several things. At our first meeting, Nora suggested selling snacks, and everyone liked the idea. She also drew up a simple plan for the food stalls. We decided we could do without a big stage, because the park already has a covered area. We are counting on volunteers to help on the day, so please tell us if you are free.
items.passageZh: 我們社團每年都會在公園辦一場小型音樂節。不過今年市政府減少了補助，所以我們必須削減好幾項開支。第一次開會時，Nora 建議賣點心，大家都覺得這個點子很好。她也草擬了一份簡單的食物攤位計畫。我們決定不搭大型舞台也行，因為公園本來就有一塊有屋頂的區域。我們很需要志工當天來幫忙，所以如果你有空，請告訴我們。

questions.questionZh: 今年社團為什麼必須削減開支？
options: 市政府給的補助比往年少
參加音樂節的人比去年少很多
公園有屋頂的區域需要整修
社團想多買一些新的音響設備

questions.questionZh: 關於今年的音樂節，下列哪一項正確？
options: 他們不打算搭建大型舞台

items.promptZh: 為了存錢，我們家決定減少在外面吃飯的次數。
referenceEn: To save money, my family decided to cut back on eating out.
My family has decided to cut back on eating out to save money.
rubricZh: 建議用提示片語 cut back 表達「減少」（例如 cut back on eating out 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 cut down on eating out、eat out less、reduce eating out 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 decided、has decided 等）
「在外面吃飯」可寫，例如 eating out、eating at restaurants 等

items.promptZh: 經理請我在下週一前草擬一份新計畫。
referenceEn: My manager asked me to draw up a new plan by next Monday.
My manager has asked me to draw up a new plan before next Monday.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「草擬」（例如 draw up a new plan 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 draft a new plan、write up a new plan、prepare a new plan 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 asked、has asked 等）
「在下週一前」可寫，例如 by next Monday、before next Monday 等
